title: Agentic Analysis for Agentic Infrastructure: An LLM-Powered Pipeline for Comparative Governance of DAO and Corporate AI Protocols
description: Computational pipeline for the comparative governance study of ERC-8004 (DAO / EIP rough consensus) and Google A2A (corporate TSC): scraping, multi-model LLM annotation, discourse metrics, and social network analysis. Version v1.1.0 adds equal-size robustness tables on top of the v1.0 R1/R2 release. The accompanying dataset is published on Hugging Face (kl41r3/erc8004-vs-a2a-governance, CC BY-NC 4.0) under a pinned revision.
